dynamicInterpretation.F: local F2 authority, exact F1 source, freeze, schema or verifier invalid
dynamicInterpretation.NF: local activation harness valid and no external activation package supplied
dynamicInterpretation.NT: external material supplied but F1 T, ingress authentication, independent readback, timing, activation signature, witness quorum or activation readback incomplete
dynamicInterpretation.T: exact F1 and A14 replay plus bounded external ingress and point-in-time activation are cryptographically verified
